notes.title: Small Update! 11-04-2017
notes.content:
Hi Guys! 

We released this version with some fixes:

Removed the "Login page" (because some users have reported that for them it was scam) 
It was a simple login page without mandatory credentials and NO STEAM ACCOUNT. 
Update of the engine to ver. 5.5

Thanks for playing the game, I'm developing a new game, soon the demo on Steam.

The Perraw Update We continue, just released the demo of the new game.

Thanks for support

-Oblion Studio 

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=787553851

notes.title: Ver. 0.5.5 available now!!
notes.content:
Hi guys!
In this version we updated various aspects of the game.

We re-realeased the map that has been removed, and now it's possible to choose one of the two maps to play with your friends!

The menu song has been replaced with the Official Song of Perraw that it'll soon become available for free as a DLC on Steam!

Soon you will be added a single player mode, similar to a tower defense!
                                                   -OblionStudioːblobberː

From today the update will be performed at 18 (Italian time)
